key_terms: Pinot's distributed query engine that supports joins and exchanges data between stages, beyond a single broker scatter and gather.
Moving intermediate rows between servers between query stages, which costs network and memory.
The rule for which values match in a join. Integer 1, string 1 and null are not automatically the same business identity.
Errors Pinot reports inside a query response, which a client must check instead of trusting an HTTP success alone.
evidence: Prepared actual Pinot Docker workshop and explicitly scoped extensions. Qualification ledger distinguishes source, native service acceptance, indexes, streaming, hybrid/upsert and multistage observations.
